description: Example: a clean corporate research facility entrance (plaza, lobby, corridor, office). Warm white painted walls, terrazzo floors, brushed steel trims, ice-blue accents.

generation.suffix: The single object alone, centered, the whole object fully inside the frame with empty margin on all sides. Three-quarter view from slightly above eye level. Pure white seamless background, flat even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no floor, no people. Photorealistic product photograph, no text, no logos.
generation.decal_suffix: Straight top-down photograph of the mark alone on a pure white background, soft irregular edges fading into the white, no objects, no shadow, no border, no text.

props.prompt: A long modern corporate reception desk with a curved front panel in glossy warm white lacquer, a pale oak wood countertop and a thin brushed steel kick strip at the base, about 3.2 metres long and 1.1 metres high.
A modern three-seat lounge sofa upholstered in light grey wool fabric with slim black metal legs, about 2.1 metres wide.
A tall matte white cylindrical floor planter holding a rubber fig plant with large glossy dark green leaves, about 1.4 metres tall in total. Chunky solid leaves.
A modern black ergonomic office task chair with a black mesh backrest, padded seat, adjustable armrests and five castors on a star base.
A simple office desk with a white laminate top and a brushed steel frame, 1.6 metres wide and 0.75 metres high, with a closed white modesty panel.
A small untidy stack of white A4 office papers and two manila folders.
A round brushed steel office waste bin, about 45 cm tall.
A slim rectangular recessed LED ceiling light panel with a thin white aluminium frame and an opal diffuser, 1.2 metres long and 30 cm wide, seen from below.

props.suffix: Flat straight-on screenshot filling the whole frame edge to edge, no monitor bezel, no perspective, no text.
props.prompt: A calm corporate looping visual: soft ice-blue abstract DNA helix ribbons over a deep navy gradient background, gentle glow.

decals.prompt: Faint grey shoe scuff marks and light dirt smears on a floor, sparse and subtle.
A soft vertical band of greyish brown dirt and hand smudges as found near the bottom of a public wall, fading upward.
A dried water puddle stain with darker rings at its edges, irregular organic shape.
